title: Your First Weekend at Fairfield University, Shared as Cards
description: A flexible Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning campus anchors, trying recreation and art stops, and making one documented trip into Fairfield.

cards.title: Friday: Establish Your Campus Base
cards.subtitle: Start where the town shuttle starts
cards.notes: Locate the shuttle departure point, check the current schedule, and save the return details before making any off-campus plans.
cards.short_summary: Use Barone as the weekend’s transportation reference point.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University identifies the Barone Campus Center as the departure point for its daily off-campus town shuttle.
cards.access_notes: Use the posted academic-year schedule; shuttle service pauses during specified breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Friday: Learn the Main Dining Stop
cards.subtitle: Find the fourth floor of Barone
cards.notes: Have a first meal here and note the location now; knowing the main dining room removes one small decision from the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Orient yourself around Fairfield’s all-you-care-to-eat student restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University places the all-you-care-to-eat Tully Dining Commons on the fourth floor of the Barone Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Meal-plan, payment, and operating details can vary; consult current Fairfield dining information before visiting.

cards.title: Friday: Find Your Academic Anchor
cards.subtitle: End the first evening with a practical stop
cards.notes: Walk through once, identify an easy meeting point, and bookmark the library site so services and building information are handy later.
cards.short_summary: Learn where to return when coursework and research begin.
cards.evidence_claim: The DiMenna-Nyselius Library provides Fairfield undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students with research, coursework, and academic-success services.
cards.access_notes: Check current building hours and student-access policies before entering.

cards.title: Saturday: Tour the RecPlex
cards.subtitle: Start the day with an active option
cards.notes: Bring your StagCard, scan the facility layout, and choose one amenity to try instead of attempting to learn the whole complex at once.
cards.short_summary: Survey the recreation choices available inside the RecPlex.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s Recreation Complex includes cardio equipment, an indoor track, courts, studios, a pool, and an e-gaming lab.
cards.access_notes: Entry is restricted to eligible members presenting a membership card or StagCard; schedules change seasonally.

cards.title: Saturday: Trace the Sculpture Map
cards.subtitle: Connect campus landmarks on foot
cards.notes: Open the museum’s map, follow a manageable section, and use the labeled artworks to practice navigating between major campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: Turn campus orientation into a self-guided art walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fairfield University Art Museum publishes a self-guiding map identifying named outdoor sculptures at multiple campus locations.
cards.source_title: Fairfield University Art Museum Outdoor Sculpture Map
cards.access_notes: Remain on appropriate campus paths and follow current visitor, building-access, and weather guidance.

cards.title: Saturday: Add a Free Gallery Stop
cards.subtitle: Slow the pace inside Bellarmine Hall
cards.notes: Check the museum’s visit page before walking over, then leave bags, food, and drinks outside the exhibition areas as required.
cards.short_summary: See permanent displays and rotating exhibitions without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bellarmine Hall Galleries display works from the museum’s permanent collection and rotating exhibitions, with free admission and no reservation required.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Fairfield University Art Museum
cards.access_notes: The galleries normally open Tuesday through Saturday and close for University holidays and inclement weather; museum rules apply.

cards.title: Saturday: Practice the Town Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Make one low-stakes off-campus loop
cards.notes: Photograph the posted timetable, confirm the last usable return, and ride only after choosing a specific stop and backup return plan.
cards.short_summary: Learn the University’s academic-year connection between campus and Fairfield destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University’s weekend town shuttle connects campus with destinations including the train station, grocery stores, a pharmacy, and Town Green.
cards.access_notes: Service is limited to the academic year, excludes listed breaks and holidays, and is subject to schedule changes.

cards.title: Saturday: Pair the Trip With Pizza
cards.subtitle: Use a named downtown destination
cards.notes: Confirm service details before leaving, set a spending limit, and treat the meal as a navigation exercise rather than an open-ended night out.
cards.short_summary: Make the first town trip concrete with pizza at the Fairfield location.
cards.evidence_claim: Colony Grill’s official site identifies a Fairfield restaurant at 1520 Post Road serving its pizza menu.
cards.access_notes: Verify same-day hours, seating, payment, and transportation details before departing campus.

cards.title: Saturday Evening: Check for a Home Game
cards.subtitle: Use the athletics schedule, not guesswork
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled home game, verify ticket and entry rules, and skip this stop if the arena calendar does not fit your weekend.
cards.short_summary: Make a campus game an optional, schedule-dependent evening stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University’s traditions page directs students to support the Stags at a home game in Mahoney Arena.
cards.access_notes: A game is not guaranteed on a given weekend; confirm the current athletics schedule, ticket requirements, and arena policies.

cards.entity_name: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.title: Sunday: Preview the Quick Center
cards.subtitle: Finish with a future cultural option
cards.notes: Browse the event calendar, identify one future program, and check student-ticket availability before committing money or coordinating a group.
cards.short_summary: Learn where Fairfield presents ticketed performances, screenings, and talks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center publishes a dated calendar of performances, screenings, and lectures and provides ticket-purchase information.
cards.source_title: Home Page | Fairfield University Quick Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Programs, age guidance, prices, and availability vary by event; consult the individual listing and box-office policies.
